evidence_items.explanation: The measured text-classification comparison supports a narrower efficiency distinction. It does not measure total deployment, lifecycle burdens, or aggregate harm from specialized AI.

evidence_items.locator: Private Investment Drops (But We See You, GenAI)
evidence_items.explanation: This establishes a substantial generative-AI investment share. The remaining investment cannot automatically be classified as specialized AI, and private investment excludes some relevant funding channels.

This is material counterevidence to an absolute reading that specialized climate applications were not receiving large funding. Its AI-related category does not cleanly exclude generative systems, so it cannot decisively settle the stated comparison.
